f07_proof_classification_audit.normalized_title: Web Application Default Credential Form Heuristic (DVWA / Mutillidae Login Endpoint)
f07_proof_classification_audit.strict_classification_rationale: Under XStrike Evidence Standard AC-02, `CONFIRMED_AUTH` requires deterministic post-authentication session proof (e.g., PostgreSQL `SELECT version()` + catalog query in F-03, FTP `230 Login successful` + directory listing in F-04/F-17, or SSH `uid=1000(msfadmin)` shell transcript in F-05). For F-07 (192.168.195.139:80 DVWA/Mutillidae) and F-09 (192.168.195.140:80 Mutillidae), the OWASP A07 scanner module submitted default credential pairs (`admin:password`, `admin:admin`) via HTTP POST and matched a 200/302 login-response heuristic WITHOUT capturing a verified session cookie (`PHPSESSID`) or post-login administrative DOM transcript. Therefore, XStrike strictly holds F-07/F-09 at `VALIDATED` (`FORM_RESPONSE_HEURISTIC_VALIDATED_NO_SESSION_COOKIE_CAPTURED`) with `mitre_execution_state = TECHNIQUE_VALIDATED` rather than inflating them to `CONFIRMED_AUTH`.
f07_proof_classification_audit.upgrade_to_confirmed_auth_requirement: Capture HTTP response `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=<token>; security=low`, follow redirect to `/dvwa/index.php` or `/mutillidae/index.php`, and verify authenticated administrative DOM marker (`Logout [admin]`).
f07_proof_classification_audit.secondary_host_note: Also normalized F-09 on 192.168.195.140:80 so Mutillidae (`admin:admin`) is accurately described as a web login form heuristic rather than claiming a verified DVWA session.

autonomous_work_packages.title: Centralized Web-Server HTTP Security Header & Cookie Policy Rollout
autonomous_work_packages.dependency: Single Virtual-Host Security Config Include (/etc/apache2/conf-available/security-headers.conf) + expose_php=Off in php.ini
autonomous_work_packages.shared_action: Deploy one unified web-server configuration policy setting CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, ServerTokens Prod, expose_php=Off, and HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie flags across all HTTP listeners.
autonomous_work_packages.coordination_state: STAGED_SINGLE_CONFIG_ROLLOUT (Note: RETEST-04 caught per-app /mutillidae/ X-Powered-By override; playbook enforces global php.ini expose_php=Off + Header always unset)
autonomous_work_packages.ansible_or_shell_playbook:
# WP-06 Autonomous Global HTTP Security Header & Cookie Policy Rollout
sed -i 's/^expose_php = On/expose_php = Off/' /etc/php5/apache2/php.ini
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/apache2/conf.d/xstrike-security-headers.conf
ServerTokens Prod
ServerSignature Off
Header always unset X-Powered-By
Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'"
Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
Header always edit Set-Cookie ^(.*)$ "$1; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax"
EOF
a2enmod headers && apache2ctl configtest && /etc/init.d/apache2 restart
